title: Update one field
summary: The update API can change selected fields of an existing document.
introduction: The update API can change selected fields of an existing document. Your task: Read document 1 after the update.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for update one field

blocks.text: The update API can change selected fields of an existing document. Its doc object describes the partial change.

Use a local Elasticsearch 8+ instance with Kibana Dev Tools. Paste the HTTP request examples into that console. Use only the cma-books practice index. This website does not connect to an Elasticsearch server.
Read the code step by step

items: The _update path selects the existing id.
The doc object supplies a partial field update, so other stored fields are kept.

blocks.text: Document 1 keeps its other fields and changes pages to 64.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A missing document id needs separate handling. Do not assume a partial update creates every missing record automatically.
